visualCharacteristics.structure: heading + rich text (paragraphs, links, lists) per item
visualCharacteristics.columns: 2x2 grid on desktop, stacked on mobile

contentPattern: Text grid (source card component without image). Rows of 2 cells; each cell holds a heading (H3, e.g. 'Speak Up', 'Vulnerability Disclosure') followed by paragraphs, inline links and bullet lists. Example: Contact Us page 2x2 grid of enquiry topics.
